description: Bulk content + schema workflow for WordPress

scripts-descriptions.test: Full suite, then the ajax group. Two passes on purpose: the WordPress test bootstrap excludes @group ajax unless it is named on the command line, so a bare `phpunit` silently skips tests/test-add-to-cart-ajax.php entirely. Composer stops on the first non-zero exit, so this is `phpunit && phpunit --group ajax`. It lives here rather than as a second CI step because CI runs `composer test` and nothing else, which is what keeps a local run identical to CI.
